notes.title: Duel of Honor Update #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44702147/de5d71f98b45b4990f5eddc9162a7cfb0e0312c5.png[/img]

[h3][b]Hello everyone, Real Pixel Game is with you and this is the second update for Duel of Honor.[/b][/h3]

Hooray, hooray, I'm back to work and I can't wait to introduce you to the new update. I apologize for not sharing the news with you for a long time, but the work was done, don't worry. Good luck, pilot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44702147/f12265316557341c3c7b24ac3ee938e0f25ed634.png[/img]

- Active camera, tracks nearby targets and smoothly takes a position between the player and the enemy.
- adding a purchase effect with an image of the product
- recycling bullets, damage 
- added new armor
- added a rocket launcher
- Added laser turrets on levels
- edited the difficulty at the beginning of the game
- writing intelligence for boss 1 and boss 2

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44702147/790f549b84ca6a5635f228ff147bf0a21bc85de4.png[/img]

- a new track has been written for the boss battle
- working on the sounds of a rocket launcher
- new sounds of explosions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44702147/c536e1f1da5730cdcbc735eaf30c2b8cf4d5ca98.png[/img]

notes.title: Duel of honor DEV #1
notes.content:
[b][h3]Duel of honor DEV #1[/h3][/b]

Hello everyone, here is the Real Pixel Game and this is the first DoH development diary. Today I will tell you about the progress of development, plans for the future and what can be expected.
[h1][b]Store[/b][/h1]
In the store you can buy the necessary body kits, boosters, weapons or modules for the bike. Everything has its price, so do not spare money, open your pocket wide.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44702147/617af62d6cdd248fc8fb8b887eb634b3d2e263a9.png[/img]
But not everything is as simple as it may seem, the game implements the mechanics of delivering the purchased goods, so you need to wait some time until your parcel is delivered to your house, unless of course it is intercepted by cunning raiders who decided to fill their bags with your goods.
[h1][b]Raiders[/b][/h1]
While you are waiting for the parcel, sitting in a comfortable chair, the raider team is sweating to take it away from you, decide what to do, help repel the attack or wait for the end of the fight, maybe you will be lucky.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44702147/009f1c7f188b240b7467b7f9f3e352c22ba4e876.png[/img]
[h1][b]Installation of spare parts[/b][/h1]
After you have waited for a valuable cargo, you need to install it on your bike using inventory resources. The required resources are indicated in a separate window and highlighted in yellow or red, depending on their availability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44702147/d74c9b91da5bc232487d30822dac3f8616d6d4b2.png[/img]
[h1][b]Redesign of the map[/b][/h1]
Improving the navigation map and the location of the arenas
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44702147/e43b7041d87f6a70056dec424a0e49d66749ee66.png[/img]
[h1][b]Garage[/b][/h1]
I'm working on the appearance of a bike in the garage. I haven't decided for sure if he's needed there, so you can write to me and we'll solve it together! have a nice day, friends)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44702147/5d98b4905bc76a01919c920fc570aec926e5aca3.png[/img]
